messages:
perf-bot: ALERT: sudden increase in stream_stalls (route=/v1/chat/stream) starting ~2109876000, p95 token-latency jump +220ms :rotating_light:

sara: yep seeing it on prod-canary, p50 fine but tail exploded around the same time as last night's runtime deploy

luke: pushed kernel-selection heuristic change (prefer_fused=true fallback_threshold=0.25) in deploy b3 at 2109875900 — could be related

anita: I grabbed a snapshot and ran perf profile on a few warm/gold traces. attaching quick notes:
```
- top hot path: aten::matmul (fused path) increased CPU spin for small sequences
- KV cache hit ratio for route /v1/chat/stream dropped from 94% -> 81% on affected host pool
- client-side ack lag (proxy) hist: 40ms 95p vs baseline 8ms
```

nima: interesting — KV miss increase could force kernel to re-evaluate seq lengths and pick non-optimal kernels mid-request, causing chunk alignment jitter

jun: prometheus queries I ran:
```
sum(rate(stream_stalls_total[5m])) by (route)
label_join(topk(5, increase(token_emit_latency_seconds_bucket[5m]) > 0), "route", ",", route)
```

ops-bot: deploy-b3 rolled back to b2 on pool-gamma at 2109876600 (automated rollback triggered by SLA alert) :white_check_mark:

sara: after rollback, tail dropped ~150ms at the pool level but client ack lag still ~30ms on a subset of proxies — looks like mixed effect

luke: ok plan: 1) re-run kernel-selection A/B with verbose selection logs for those sequence-length buckets, 2) add per-route KV miss instrumentation (already on roadmap), 3) add a fast health probe to detect kernel thrashing and fallback to stable profile

anita: also adding a dashboard panel for per-route token-latency breakdown by emit-side (client vs server) and KV-miss-rate overlay. proto query: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_emit_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, emit_side))`

nima: I'll attach a small repro harness to simulate kv miss spikes + small-batch kernel selection so we can reproduce locally

jun: one more datapoint: the affected traces show chunk-size oscillation (sometimes 8 tokens then 3 tokens then 12) — looks like batching heuristic interacting with KV misses

sara: tagging infra oncall and runtime to prioritize — @luke @nima please take the lead, we'll keep this thread for updates :eyes:

perf-bot: trace links: https://perf.internal/trace/2109876543, saved profiling snapshot: s3://redwood-profiles/2109876543-snapshot.pb

luke: starting with verbose kernel logs on canary pool, will post findings in next hour

anita: created dashboard ticket INF-1423 and added initial panels + alert rule for per-route p95 token-latency delta > 100ms vs baseline

ops-bot: note: incident runbook reminder -> if rollback doesn't recover tail within 15m, escalate to SRE and open a P0

sara: thanks everyone — if anyone sees new regressions post-rollback drop a short message here
